description: Spatial causal network for green hydrogen production in the Fitzroy region, Queensland is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by CSIRO Data Access Portal. This dataset was compiled by the Water for Sustainable Hydrogen project from source data referenced within the dataset and/or metadata. The spatial causal network comprises a rigorous and scientific assessment of potential causal pathways by which hydrogen and renewable energy development can affect environmental assets. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher CSIRO Data Access Portal. It offers 957 resource(s) in bin, html, xlsx. The portal shows 2025-12-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
